pages.title: CA client and enrollment flows
pages.purpose: Document the cautils package: online vs offline CA clients, the certificate enrollment flow, the one-time token flow, ACME flow, bootstrap flow, and how provisioners are selected.
instructions: Explain online/offline mode selection, audience construction, provisioner prompting/filtering, and failure behavior. Cite evidence per flow.

pages.title: CLI runtime, flag system, and error handling
pages.purpose: Explain how the urfave/cli application is constructed and executed: app lifecycle, global flags, help templates, plugin dispatch, STEPDEBUG error reporting, and the exec helper.
instructions: Ground claims in internal/cmd/root.go and internal/plugin/plugin.go. Explain STEPPATH/STEPDEBUG behavior only where source establishes it.

pages.title: Step CLI architecture overview
pages.purpose: Map the repository as a whole: the step CLI's responsibility, module layout, command registration model, entrypoint, and major command groups.
instructions: Describe ownership boundaries between command packages, shared utilities, and cli-utils dependencies. Cite entrypoint and registration evidence.

pages.title: Provisioning tokens: claims, options, and parsing
pages.purpose: Document the token package: JWT claim structure and options, validity constraints, token parsing and type detection, and per-provisioner token generation.
instructions: Ground all claims in token/ source files. Note which provisioner types exist and how Payload.Type() detects them.

pages.title: step ca command group
pages.purpose: Document the ca command group: init (PKI generation and deployment types), bootstrap, token, certificate, sign, renew, revoke, rekey, root/roots, health, and the provisioner/admin/policy/acme subcommand trees.
instructions: Explain ca init's deployment types and file outputs, and the admin/provisioner/policy management surfaces. Cite init.go and provisioner evidence.

pages.title: step certificate command group
pages.purpose: Document the certificate command group: create (profiles, templates, CSRs), sign, inspect, verify, lint, bundle, format, key, install/uninstall, p12, fingerprint, needsRenewal, and remote.
instructions: Explain certificate profiles, default templates/validity, KMS-backed keys, and CSR flow. Cite create.go and sign.go evidence.

pages.title: step crypto command group
pages.purpose: Document the crypto command group: JOSE/JWT/JWS/JWE, JWK key management, KDFs, hashing, NaCl, TOTP, key handling, random, and Windows PE utilities.
instructions: Describe the insecure/subtle gating policy and safe defaults. Cite crypto.go security considerations and kdf evidence.

pages.title: step oauth command
pages.purpose: Document the oauth command: OAuth 2.0 authorization code, device, JWT-bearer, and OOB flows, provider discovery, and output modes.
instructions: Describe supported flows and flags. Note where the default Google client IDs live and how output modes work.

pages.title: step ssh command group and SSH utilities
pages.purpose: Document the ssh command group and internal/sshutil: certificate signing flows, SSH agent integration, login/logout/list, config, hosts, inspect, proxycommand, and the remote shell implementation.
instructions: Explain identity certificates, client-authentication-required CAs, host IDs, agent add/remove semantics, and proxycommand.

pages.title: Testing strategy
pages.purpose: Document the repository's testing approach: unit tests across internal packages, focused package tests, and the integration testscript harness.
instructions: Describe the txtar testscript harness usage and which layers are covered. Cite test files.

pages.title: Change guide: adding a step command
pages.purpose: Focused change guide for adding a new subcommand: package layout, registration via cli-utils command.Register, flags reuse, error conventions, and testing.
instructions: Follow the documented command-add workflow from command/README.md and cite registration evidence.

pages.title: Change guide: extending provisioner token support
pages.purpose: Focused change guide for adding or extending a CA provisioner token flow: token claim options, token type detection, token generation, and the provisioner prompt filters.
instructions: Explain the touchpoints for a new provisioner type grounded in token_flow.go and token_generator.go.

pages.title: Build, packaging, and release
pages.purpose: Document how the step binary is built, tested, packaged, and released: Makefile targets, GoReleaser config, docker images, systemd units, shell autocompletion, and OS packaging scripts.
instructions: Ground claims in Makefile and .goreleaser.yml. Do not invent release infrastructure not present in source.

pages.title: Step CLI quickstart
pages.purpose: Practical quickstart: build the binary, run common commands across groups, understand STEPPATH configuration, and route readers to relevant wiki pages.
instructions: Keep commands concrete and verifiable against command help text. Reference other wiki pages for depth.
